issue.title: Dependency issues during installation on Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS
issue.body:
### Generated by Generative AI

_No response_

### Operating System:

Linux myname 6.8.0-85-generic #85~22.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Sep 19 16:18:59 UTC 2 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

### ROS version or commit hash:

ROS2 Humble Hawksbill 

### RMW implementation (if applicable):

_No response_

### RMW Configuration (if applicable):

Dear ladies and gentlemen,

I currently try to install ros-humble-desktop on my Linux system. The system information is given with `uname -a` in the operating system info, further information is given via `cat /etc/os-release` and the output follows as:

```
PRETTY_NAME="Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS"
NAME="Ubuntu"
VERSION_ID="22.04"
VERSION="22.04.5 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)"
VERSION_CODENAME=jammy
ID=ubuntu
ID_LIKE=debian
HOME_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/"
SUPPORT_URL="https://help.ubuntu.com/"
BUG_REPORT_URL="https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/"
PRIVACY_POLICY_URL="https://www.ubuntu.com/legal/terms-and-policies/privacy-policy"
UBUNTU_CODENAME=jammy
```

During the installation, I follow the guide (https://docs.ros.org/en/humble/Installation/Ubuntu-Install-Debs.html) and everything works successful until the command `sudo apt install ros-humble-desktop`. Then, errors appear according to the following output:

```
Reading package lists... Done
Building dependency tree... Done
Reading state information... Done
Some packages could not be installed. This may mean that you have
requested an impossible situation or if you are using the unstable
distribution that some required packages have not yet been created
or been moved out of Incoming.
The following information may help to resolve the situation:

The following packages have unmet dependencies:
 libpulse-dev : Depends: libpulse0 (= 1:15.99.1+dfsg1-1ubuntu1) but 1:15.99.1+dfsg1-1ubuntu2.2 is to be installed
                Depends: libpulse-mainloop-glib0 (= 1:15.99.1+dfsg1-1ubuntu1) but 1:15.99.1+dfsg1-1ubuntu2.2 is to be installed
 libusb-1.0-0-dev : Depends: libusb-1.0-0 (= 2:1.0.25-1ubuntu1) but 2:1.0.25-1ubuntu2 is to be installed
                    Recommends: libusb-1.0-doc but it is not going to be installed
 qtbase5-dev : Depends: libqt5core5a (= 5.15.3+dfsg-2) but 5.15.3+dfsg-2ubuntu0.2 is to be installed
               Depends: libqt5dbus5 (= 5.15.3+dfsg-2) but 5.15.3+dfsg-2ubuntu0.2 is to be installed
               Depends: libqt5gui5 (= 5.15.3+dfsg-2) but 5.15.3+dfsg-2ubuntu0.2 is to be installed
               Depends: libqt5network5 (= 5.15.3+dfsg-2) but 5.15.3+dfsg-2ubuntu0.2 is to be installed
               Depends: libqt5widgets5 (= 5.15.3+dfsg-2) but 5.15.3+dfsg-2ubuntu0.2 is to be installed
E: Unable to correct problems, you have held broken packages.
```


It seems that a similar issue has been addressed and solved in https://github.com/ros2/ros2/issues/1756. However, I cannot find a solving procedure in that issue. Did anyone else face similar issues and knows how to solve?

Thank you in advance and best regards!
Max

_No response_

### 'ros2 doctor --report' output

<details><summary>ros2 doctor --report</summary>

```console
<COPY OUTPUT HERE>
```
</details>


### Steps to reproduce issue

1. Setup locale
locale  # check for UTF-8
sudo apt update && sudo apt install locales
sudo locale-gen en_US en_US.UTF-8
sudo update-locale LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 LANG=en_US.UTF-8
export LANG=en_US.UTF-8
locale  # verify settings
2. Setup sources
sudo apt install software-properties-common
sudo add-apt-repository universe
sudo apt update && sudo apt install curl -y
export ROS_APT_SOURCE_VERSION=$(curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/ros-infrastructure/ros-apt-source/releases/latest | grep -F "tag_name" | awk -F'"' '{print $4}')
curl -L -o /tmp/ros2-apt-source.deb "https://github.com/ros-infrastructure/ros-apt-source/releases/download/${ROS_APT_SOURCE_VERSION}/ros2-apt-source_${ROS_APT_SOURCE_VERSION}.$(. /etc/os-release && echo ${UBUNTU_CODENAME:-${VERSION_CODENAME}})_all.deb"
sudo dpkg -i /tmp/ros2-apt-source.deb
3. Install ROS2 packages
sudo apt update
sudo apt upgrade
sudo apt install ros-humble-desktop

### Expected behavior

Should install ros-humble-desktop

### Actual behavior

Breaks installation due to broken packages

### Additional information

Technically, the packages could be installed manually. However, LLMs and forums recommend not to manually install them, since this could infere with the entire system.

comments.body:
Maybe instead of executing only `sudo apt update` you could also try using `sudo apt full-upgrade`. Make sure to update all of the packages to the most recent stable version as decided by the apt package manager.

From the logs it seems that the apt repository is reporting a mismatch with the installed packages. I had this issue in another ros package installation and spent some time digging around. Also check if you have the correct apt sources for Ubuntu.

Make sure especially you have the "jammy-updates" source listed in sources.list

If the above does not work you could try using a smaller deb package for example `sudo apt install ros-humble-ros-base` or use the binary archive install. This might help you narrow down whether the problem is really within ros or with your system setup.

I have the exact system but I upgraded my kernel a few days ago. My current version is `6.8.0-110-generic #110~22.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri Mar 27 12:43:08 UTC  x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux`

Maybe upgrading your kernel might solve the issue as well but I am no expert in this case.
